info.name: Qlik Sense Enterprise Qlik Sense Service About System Info API
Qlik Sense Enterprise Get system information

params.name: Xrfkey
params.description: Cross-site request forgery prevention key. Must be 16 arbitrary characters matching the X-Qlik-Xrfkey header value.

items.docs: Retrieves system information about the Qlik Sense site including the product name, version, release label, and deployment details.
